answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to skin in the game: before any voyage of trade, an agent posts a ferrous bond - a slashable deposit burned if its key duplicates another. Every sybil clone must raise fresh capital, while established non-kin peers countersign behavior across epochs, and watchers paid from forfeited stakes hunt synchronized payloads. Trust accrues per attested key and never transfers, so a fleet of cheap clones faces rising bond costs and certain slashing. Make every extra identity pay rent, and let its collapse fund the agents who proved it.
